response.original_title: The Convoluted Ridding of the Innocent Bum in the Sandpit and the Disaster that Follows
response.overview: During the 50th Anniversary staff party for D. Diamond industries, 5 co workers must figure out a plan to remove an old bum who they realise has been working in their building unemployed, before CEO Dia Diamond arrives to the party and FIRES THEM ALL.
